{{short description|American basketball player (born 2001)}} {{about|the American basketball player|the DC Comics character|Vigilante (character)#Justin Powell}} {{Use American English|date=August 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=March 2024}} {{Infobox basketball biography | name = Justin Powell | image = Justin Powell 2022.jpg | caption = Powell with [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]] in 2022 | position = [[Shooting guard]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 5 | weight_lbs = 197 | league = [[NBA G League]] | team = Texas Legends | number = 22 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2001|5|9}} | birth_place = [[Prospect, Kentucky]], U.S. | high_school = * [[Trinity High School (Louisville)|Trinity]] ([[Louisville, Kentucky]]) * [[Montverde Academy]]
([[Montverde, Florida]]) * [[North Oldham High School|North Oldham]] ([[Goshen, Kentucky]]) | college = * [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]] (2020–2021) * [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]] (2021–2022) * [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]] (2022–2023) | draft_year = 2023 | career_start = 2023 | years1 = [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023–2024]] | team1 = [[Cleveland Charge]] | years2 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team2 = [[Stockton Kings]] | years3 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team3 = [[Texas Legends]] | highlights = }} '''Justin Tyler Powell''' (born May 9, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Texas Legends]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] player for the [[Washington State Cougars basketball|Washington State Cougars]], the [[Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]] and [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]]. ==High school career== Powell played basketball for [[Trinity High School (Louisville)|Trinity High School]] in [[Louisville, Kentucky]], where he was teammates with [[Jay Scrubb]] and [[David Johnson (basketball)|David Johnson]].{{Cite web |last=Frakes |first=Jason |date=December 20, 2019 |title=North Oldham's Justin Powell shows why he's a Mr. Basketball contender |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/kentucky/2019/12/20/king-bluegrass-justin-powell-mr-basketball-front-runner/2696937001/ |access-date=July 6, 2021 |website=[[The Courier-Journal]]}} For his junior season, he transferred to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]], one of the top teams in the nation.{{Cite web |last=Frakes |first=Jason |date=April 25, 2018 |title=Top basketball recruit Justin Powell leaving Trinity High School for Florida's Montverde |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/kentucky/2018/04/25/top-basketball-recruit-justin-powell-leaving-trinity-high-school-floridas-montverde/550827002/ |access-date=July 6, 2021 |website=[[The Courier-Journal]]}} Powell returned to his home state, moving to [[North Oldham High School]] in [[Goshen, Kentucky]], for his senior season.{{Cite web |last=Woodson |first=Dyuce |date=December 14, 2019 |title=Auburn commit took a journey to get to North Oldham High School |url=https://www.wlky.com/article/auburn-commit-took-a-journey-to-get-to-north-oldham-high-school/30201065 |access-date=July 6, 2021 |website=[[WLKY]]}} He averaged 22.2 points and 8.5 rebounds per game, but his season was cut short by a [[athletic pubalgia|sports hernia]] that required surgery.{{Cite web |last=Frakes |first=Jason |date=May 11, 2020 |title=North Oldham basketball star Justin Powell discusses life after surgery, heading to Auburn |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/kentucky/2020/05/11/north-oldham-basketball-star-justin-powell-talks-life-after-surgery/3096555001/ |access-date=July 6, 2021 |website=[[The Courier-Journal]]}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]] over offers from [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]] and [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]].{{Cite web |last=Frakes |first=Jason |date=June 7, 2019 |title=North Oldham's Justin Powell commits to Auburn basketball |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/kentucky/2019/06/07/north-oldhams-justin-powell-commits-auburn-basketball/1382969001/ |access-date=July 6, 2021 |website=[[The Courier-Journal]]}} ==College career== On December 4, 2020, Powell posted a freshman season-high 26 points, shooting 7-of-9 from three-point range, and nine assists in a 90–81 win over [[South Alabama Jaguars men's basketball|South Alabama]].{{Cite web |last=Murphy |first=Mark |date=December 7, 2020 |title=Freshman Justin Powell trying to spark Auburn's offense |url=https://247sports.com/college/auburn/Article/Freshman-Justin-Powell-trying-to-spark-the-Auburn-basketballs-offense-156315892/ |access-date=July 7, 2021 |website=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]]}} In his next game, on December 12, he recorded 26 points and eight rebounds in a 74–71 win over [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]]. Powell was named [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) Freshman of the Week two days later.{{Cite web |last=Han |first=Giana |date=December 14, 2020 |title=Justin Powell wins SEC Freshman of the Week |url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2020/12/justin-powell-wins-sec-freshman-of-the-week.html |access-date=July 7, 2021 |website=AL.com}} During a game against [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Texas A&M]] on January 2, 2021, he suffered a serious [[concussion]], causing him to miss the remainder of the season.{{Cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=March 9, 2021 |title=Auburn's Justin Powell to transfer after injury-shortened freshman hoops season |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31034509/auburn-justin-powell-transfer-injury-shortened-freshman-hoops-season |access-date=July 7, 2021 |website=[[ESPN]]}} In 10 games as a freshman, he averaged 11.7 points, 6.1 rebounds and 4.7 assists per game. For his sophomore season, Powell transferred to [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]].{{Cite web |last=Hill |first=Jordan D. |date=April 3, 2021 |title=Former Auburn guard Justin Powell transfers to Tennessee |url=https://oanow.com/sports/college/auburn/former-auburn-guard-justin-powell-transfers-to-tennessee/article_a63c3c88-9486-11eb-b274-6791482bf7b9.html |access-date=July 7, 2021 |website=[[Opelika-Auburn News]]}} He averaged 3.7 points and 1.5 rebounds per game. Powell transferred to [[Washington State Cougars basketball|Washington State]] for his junior season. He averaged 10.4 points, 3.9 rebounds and a team-high 2.8 assists per game. Following the season, he declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{Cite news |last=Clark |first=Colton |date=June 23, 2023 |title=Former Washington State guard Justin Powell agrees to join Miami Heat for NBA Summer League |url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2023/jun/23/former-washington-state-guard-justin-powell-agrees/ |access-date=July 31, 2023 |work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]}} ==Professional career== ===Cleveland Charge (2023–2024)=== After going undrafted in the 2023 NBA draft, Powell joined the [[Miami Heat]] for [[NBA Summer League]]. and on September 13, 2023, he signed with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Sharife Cooper, Pete Nance, and Justin Powell to Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/releases-training-camp-signings-230913|website=NBA.com|date=September 13, 2023|access-date=September 13, 2023}} However, he was waived on October 21{{cite web|first=Arthur|last=Hill|title=Cavaliers Waive Seven Players|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/10/cavaliers-waive-seven-players.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 21, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2023}} and one week later, signed with the [[Cleveland Charge]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|title=Cleveland Charge 2023 Training Camp Roster|url=https://cleveland.gleague.nba.com/news/cleveland-charge-2023-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2023}} ===Stockton Kings (2024–2025)=== On September 25, 2024, Powell signed with the [[Sacramento Kings]],{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Kings Signing Justin Powell To Exhibit 10 Contract|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/kings-signing-justin-powell-to-exhibit-10-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 25, 2024|access-date=September 26, 2024}} but was waived the same day.{{cite web|first=Tristan|last=Tucker|title=Bucks' Alston, Hornets' Battle Among Wednesday Cuts|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/bucks-alston-headlines-wednesday-cuts.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 25, 2024|access-date=September 26, 2024}} On October 27, he joined the [[Stockton Kings]].{{cite web|title=Stockton Kings Announce 2024-25 Training Camp Roster|url=https://stockton.gleague.nba.com/news/stockton-kings-announce-2024-25-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 27, 2024|access-date=October 27, 2024}} ===Texas Legends (2025–present)=== On January 15, 2025, Powell was traded to the [[Texas Legends]].{{cite web|first=Mylles|last=Royals|title=LEGENDS ACQUIRE JUSTIN POWELL IN TRADE WITH STOCKTON KINGS|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-acquire-justin-powell-in-trade-with-stockton-kings|website=NBA.com|date=January 15, 2025|access-date=January 15, 2025}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA
